introduce:
Sit with your hands behind your ears and elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, raise your right knee and rotate your upper body to the right, bringing your left elbow to meet your right knee.

Inhale, return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR ELBOW TO KNEE CRUNCH

tips.text: Tighten your abdominals during the exercise.
Raise your knee up as high as you can.
Squeeze your abdominals with each crunch.
Exhale as you lift your knee and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise works on your entire core.

introduce:
Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, lean from your waist and contract your obliques, bending to one side as far as possible.

Inhale, return to the starting position. Switch sides and repeat.
name: CHAIR SIDE BEND

tips.text: Keep a straight back and braced core during the exercise.
Exhale as you bend to the side, and inhale as you return.
You can feel your obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:
Sit with your heels resting on the ground.

Exhale, lift your right leg and clap your hands under your raised knee.

Inhale, lower it back down. Switch legs and repeat.
name: CHAIR CLAP CRUNCH

tips.text: Exhale when you lift your leg, and inhale when you lower it.
To get more of a challenge, keep your leg straight.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your abdominal muscles.
